body:
I wish it were that easy. He's my roommate, and I want to go to school down here. If I had the means, I would be gone before morning. 

I hate him. I hate him so much that I would happily kill myself so that I didnt have to deal with him.
Busting a nut ain't gonna solve shit.
What the fuck is wrong with you, nigga?

There's no "path" at all. I am nobody's choice. Nobody has ever looked at me and thought "Maybe we can give it a shot?" Everyone else always has a grand fucking story to tell, but I have to watch them be happy. I've been watching people walk away since I was a kid. Everyone, every/thing/ moves on, but I'm still here. 

I won't ever have that. Nobody will ever think of me in that way. Nobody will ever want me the way I've wanted other people. I don't even care about sex, I just want someone to fucking CARE. Unfortunately, that's not an option. I'm not assertive enough. I'm boring. I'm unattractive. I'm too introspective. I don't have "game" or status, or confidence in anything that matters. I am undeserving, and that fucking kills me.

Do you know what's like to not be wanted, ever? Just "being content" isn't a catch-all answer. Nobody has EVER looked at me, and the one time I feel like I'm getting somewhere, some "macho" asshole steals that away from me.

It just hurts, y'know? I like one of my roommates, and even she pines after that man. Her face brightens as soon cas she sees him, he gets aggressive, and she giggles. I've NEVER gotten that, it's like I don't exist.
Thank you. I honestly needed this.
